dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The dorsal region features multiple light-colored geometric structures. Three prominent 'O' shaped rings display high-contrast, high-frequency edge transitions from dark exterior pixels to a thin high-intensity perimeter, enclosing a lower-intensity dark center. Two 'C' shaped structures show similar perimeter intensity with open-ended geometries oriented towards the posterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters is observed on the lower lateral region. These clusters are asymmetrical, lacking internal gradients, and exhibit a tighter concentration (higher local density) compared to the more dispersed macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest closed-loop annuli form a scalene triangle with the longest side oriented longitudinally. Connecting the centroids of four smaller, sequential rings along the dorsal ridge reveals a slightly curved, non-linear geometric relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture topology transitions from discrete isolated rings to a continuous reticulated mesh in the mid-dorsal area, where individual high-intensity perimeters share common nodes.
